claim.statement: GitLab's official documentation describes Code Review Flow as a publisher-hosted service; the catalog keeps that delivery path separate from other GitLab Duo Agent Platform surfaces.

source.title: Code Review Flow
source.locator: Official publisher page reviewed for the named surface and delivery boundary

lifecycle.reason: The claim is admitted only for the named record, reviewed source and applicability boundary.

limitations: The documented delivery model is an applicability boundary, not evidence of product quality, runtime behavior or suitability.
unknowns: GitLab release, GitLab.com versus Self-Managed versus Dedicated offering, selected or self-hosted model, runner and top-level group settings determine applicability
Agentic Code Review Flow must be separated from the non-agentic GitLab Duo Code Review feature
Manual reviewer assignment, Agentic Chat handoff and automatic review are distinct trigger and approval paths
Features documented for unreleased GitLab 19.3 are outside the selected 19.2 boundary
